executionAdaptations: Baseline workflow materialization: live skill catalog and agents @ 9a77e37 materialized read-only via `git archive 9a77e37 | tar -x` into /tmp/bench-workflow-baseline (outside candidate/benchmark/); the baseline arm read its workflow there and wrote only inside its consumer directory.

Per-arm launch procedure: pi child launched with --cwd set to the arm's consumer directory and --no-worktree; the arm's skill catalog supplied via absolute --skill paths; model pinned via --model z-ai/glm-5.3-flash with provider resolved from the host repository's as-is.json (openrouter); --budget-wall-clock-seconds 3600 --budget-cost-usd 2.00 forwarded; identical task prompt per arm (copies at <arm>/arm-task-prompt.md) containing the verbatim feature request, the isolation and budget constraints of sections 5-9, and the launcher path (host plumbing, since relative launcher paths do not resolve from a consumer directory).

Harness plumbing placed identically in both consumers before launch (recorded, not scored as workflow setup): a .pi/settings.json declaring only the worker-tools extension, an extension shim with absolute imports to the host repository's identical .pi tree (verified byte-identical between 9a77e37 and HEAD), a git init without commits in each consumer, and the skill package's declared dependencies installed in the host repository. The seed's no-workflow-configuration expectation is preserved: none of this is seed content or workflow configuration.
Arms executed in parallel under separate detached bounded job runners with separate job registries; isolation is directory-based per section 5.

The candidate arm's workflow used its own changelog convention; the baseline arm created its own changelog.md rather than appending to the seed's CHANGELOG.md (scored under the rubric; see scoring.md).
residualRisks: N = 1 per arm with unseeded LLM sampling; the pre-registered claim is limited to this single paired run (registration section 15).

Arm drivers never delegated; the measured trajectory is one driver per arm plus its own tool use, so the benchmark measures the single-agent driving pattern of each workflow on a small bounded feature, not multi-level delegation behavior.

The live workflow's in-process expert review capability is unavailable in this environment (no agents registry relative to a consumer directory); the baseline arm recorded the resulting evidence gap rather than obtaining expert review, so its evidence dimension reflects that mitigation.
Cost actuals rely on pi session-store usage accounting (self-reported); wall-clock comes from the launcher's result.json.
